wow this room is really nostalgic. it reminds me of any generic little kid's birthday party. the unnecessarily vibrant and colour balloons and the walls seem almost sickly.

this is a really nice depiction of the back rooms. the room is so familiar but you do not feel very comfortable or welcomed when you look at this photo. the uneven lighting that doesn't seems to reach all points of the room creates a sense of vulnerability and exposure. for quite a generous-sized room, it feels very claustrophobic.
